name: Encik Hamzah
bio: Hamzah is the suspended dealer behind the Kim Hong nutmeg. He still has buyers, but needs someone else to stand at the scales.
notes: gameplay: Hamzah owns the nutmeg in case_001, not the Kim Hong. His home port and regional bloc are roster choices, not a documented origin or office. The fish mark and the cargo seals are gameplay inventions (data/inspections/case_001.json; docs/research/seals-marks-packaging.md)
gameplay: The Pulau Star is a proposed coastal perahu carrying nutmeg near Tioman. The existing case only describes an unnamed prau coming alongside (data/inspections/case_001.json)

gameplay: If the nutmeg reaches the bazaar he funds another cheap lot through the broker's yard; if held, he asks the temenggung for a hearing and tries to keep Tan Bo from giving a full account (data/events/ev_kim_hong_whispers.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §09)
